digest.component_or_area: reconciler committed .bridge_state cache and tickets repository
propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% being the reconciler's .bridge_state cache; baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass fields cause 1164 scattered edits per pass that defeat git delta compression.

Deleting baseline_advanced_at timestamp reduces marginal packed cost from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB per version (7.4x savings); moving last_get_pass to a sidecar file halves version count (12.8x total savings).

The .bridge_state cache must remain on-branch because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners and requires durable state in git; re-homing was evaluated and rejected because the convergence loop self-heals binding drift.

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces the repository from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49888 commits and 2661 merges, with HEAD tree byte-identical to pre-rewrite state.

Rollout gates require descendant workflow execution proof, explicit host refresh with epoch mismatch refusal at both union sites, live review-bot demonstration, verified off-repo backup bundle, and quiesced publication window with operator attestation.

Post-publish rollback is a second quiesced window that restores the old tickets tip with force-with-lease and resets all writers to avoid epoch mismatch; this preserves fail-closed behavior while making the bundle executable as recovery.
